campi_del_mandato.environmental_conditions: Water saturation per date; season declared
campi_del_mandato.instrument: Simultaneous radon and thoron exhalation measurement; soil parameters in the paper's tables
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: Th-232 not published, so no thoron validation is possible. The row-to-date pairing is not explicit in the source: the comparison stays per point.
campi_del_mandato.sampling_frequency: One campaign per season per point
campi_del_mandato.site: Kobe, Japan, Mount Rokko weathered granite, seven measurement points
campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: Dry and grain density, porosity, Ra-226 and water saturation at each date; emanation measured against moisture
campi_del_mandato.split: Validation restricted to points 1 and 2 (undisturbed, off campus). Points 3, 5, 6, 7 are exploratory only: campus ground, anthropogenic disturbance. The per-date file is exploratory only.
campi_del_mandato.timestamp: May, August, November 2007 and January 2008 (four seasons)
campi_del_mandato.units: Ra-226 Bq/kg; density kg/m3 and g/cm3; porosity and saturation dimensionless; flux mBq/m2/s
